accountability.intended_use: formal within-dataset evaluation for a computer-science final-year project
accountability.ai_assistance: AI assisted protocol drafting; the team and supervisor retain scientific accountability

prior_access.interpretation_boundary: This is a prospective formal evaluation after exploratory model selection on the same public dataset. It is internal repeated grouped validation, not independent external replication.

research_program.research_question: Under a cat-ID-disjoint MeowAgeNet evaluation, does low-parameter AST adaptation improve animal-level feline age classification relative to the locked VGGish+MLP baseline and a matched frozen-AST head-only control?
research_program.working_claim_if_supported: Low-parameter AST adaptation improves MeowAgeNet animal-level age classification under the declared internal validation protocol.
research_program.claim_not_targeted: The protocol does not treat probe-guided layer selection as a uniquely established mechanism.

H048.statement: The frozen primary AST adapter candidate improves animal-level macro F1 over the locked VGGish+MLP pipeline.

H019.statement: Adding the matched low-parameter adapters improves animal-level macro F1 over the frozen-AST head-only pipeline.

rivals: The apparent gain is produced by split or optimization variability.
The gain comes from the revised AST training recipe or classifier head rather than adapter updates.
Generic cross-depth placement performs similarly, so probe guidance is not the active ingredient.
Repeated reuse of the same 111 cats inflates apparent generalization.

dataset.failure_policy: Abort the formal run if checksums, counts, labels, or required files differ. Do not silently exclude additional calls or cats.

splits.design: five repeats of four-fold stratified cat-ID-disjoint outer cross-validation
splits.test_rule: Each cat appears in exactly one outer-test fold per repeat and never crosses train, validation, and test within a repeat-fold.
splits.new_split_limitation: New deterministic partitions reduce exact reuse of v1 folds but do not create new animals or external validation.

model_randomness.pairing_rule: Use the same base seed, repeat, and outer fold for every matched pipeline.

vggish.recipe: inherit the audited meowagenet-locked-v1 VGGish+MLP preprocessing, head, aggregation, and class weighting

ast.segment_pooling: arithmetic mean of AST pooler_output embeddings or probabilities within each call as required by the matched training implementation
ast.geometry_policy: standard AST geometry only; IDEA-012 geometry variants are excluded from formal v2

primary_candidate.initialization: zero-initialized up projection so the adapter starts as an identity mapping

layer_selection.data_boundary: only inner-train cats for the current repeat and outer fold
layer_selection.probe: StandardScaler plus balanced multinomial logistic regression with C=1.0, lbfgs, max_iter=2000
layer_selection.selection_rule: select the top two distinct layers
layer_selection.selection_freeze: selected layers are fixed before adapter training and outer-test prediction for that repeat-fold

confirmatory_core.role: matched control for the adapter incremental effect

required_diagnostics.sampling_frame: uniform without replacement from all 66 unordered pairs of 12 AST layers
required_diagnostics.aggregation_rule: report the distribution and mean metric across the two pair-specific models; do not ensemble their probabilities
required_diagnostics.role: estimate generic placement variability without claiming a single lucky random pair is representative

excluded_from_formal_v2: additional PEFT families or unregistered placements

training.class_weight: balanced, fitted from the current training cats only
training.epoch_selection: select the best epoch using inner validation only, then refit on outer train plus validation cats for the selected epoch count
training.invalid_run_policy: A non-finite result, exception, corrupted artifact, or checksum mismatch is a technical failure. Retry only the identical configuration after documenting the cause; any configuration change is a protocol deviation.

evaluation.probability_aggregation: arithmetic mean of class probabilities within cat_id, then argmax
evaluation.pipeline_comparison_boundary: VGGish and AST retain their audited native preprocessing. The comparison is between complete pipelines and does not identify a pure architecture effect.

analysis.oof_construction: For each repeat and model seed, concatenate the four outer-test predictions so all 111 cats contribute exactly once.
analysis.pipeline_summary: Report the mean, standard deviation, minimum, maximum, and all 15 complete-OOF metric values.
analysis.contrast_summary: Compute paired candidate-minus-comparator differences within every repeat and model seed, then report their mean and distribution.
analysis.uncertainty: Use 10000 hierarchical paired bootstrap replicates. In each replicate, stratified-resample cats once and apply the same sampled cats to all pipelines; resample split repeats and model seeds with replacement; report the percentile 95% interval of the mean paired difference.
analysis.consistency: Report the number of the 15 complete-OOF evaluations with a positive paired difference. Do not substitute best-fold or best-seed results for the full summary.
analysis.multiplicity: H048 is the primary performance contrast and H019 is the prespecified key method contrast. Random, distributed, last-2, secondary metrics, and layer correlations are diagnostic; do not promote them to primary after results are known.
analysis.missing_predictions: A formal pipeline is incomplete if any expected cat lacks a finite probability vector. Do not calculate the primary result on a reduced cat set.
analysis.deviation_policy: Preserve the frozen protocol and append every deviation with date, reason, result-awareness status, and likely interpretive effect.

interpretation_rules.full_route_support: H048 and H019 both have positive mean paired differences, at least 12 of 15 complete-OOF differences are positive for each contrast, and each 95% interval excludes zero. Label a mean H048 difference of at least 0.03 as practically meaningful.
interpretation_rules.practical_but_uncertain: The mean H048 difference reaches 0.03 but its interval includes zero or fewer than 12 of 15 paired evaluations are positive. Report the effect estimate and uncertainty without a stable-improvement claim.
interpretation_rules.directional_only: The mean difference is above zero but below 0.03. Describe it as a small directional effect.
interpretation_rules.not_supported: A mean difference at or below zero does not support the corresponding improvement hypothesis under formal v2.
interpretation_rules.probe_guidance_boundary: Probe-guided superiority is not a primary claim. Interpret its diagnostic contrasts against distributed and random placements without semantic claims about unique age-information layers.

formal_artifacts_required: frozen protocol and split manifests with SHA256
per-cat probabilities for every repeat, fold, seed, and pipeline
complete result tables and hierarchical-bootstrap output
stopping_rule: Run the complete frozen matrix. Do not stop the study because an interim result is favorable or unfavorable. New models, losses, placements, or tuning choices require a separately labeled exploratory protocol or a later version.

execution.reference_hardware: one NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti 8GB or a documented compatible GPU
